head_commit.message:
PR route: accept protected files of any trusted verifier revision, and check them at selection

The publisher required the PR head and the run controller to hold exactly the
protected files (.github/workflows, scripts, profiles, challenges, patches) of
the publisher's own revision. So each verifier push made every open PR
submission fail its publication: on 2026-10-21 the publisher closed PR #29
after its Lean check passed, because 80d2058 changed scripts/verifier.py after
the PR branched from c1893bc.

Now each of these commits must hold exactly the protected files of one trusted
revision: this checkout, or a revision in the site's data/direct-trust.json at
the site's current main commit (controller_blobs and previous_controller_blobs).
The site adds a trust entry before each verifier push. A PR still cannot change a
protected file to anything untrusted (a changed, added, removed or mode-changed
protected file, or a protected directory that is a file or symlink, matches no
revision). If the trust list cannot be read (any network or parse error), the PR
stays open for review and is not closed. The trust read uses the API opener that
drops the token on a redirect outside api.github.com.

The selector now runs the same check on the PR head before admission. On a
mismatch it spends no run, does not admit the head, and posts one comment per
head that asks the author to click "Update branch".

Reviewed by Data Pipeline (2026-10-21): SHIP; its LOW 1-3 are folded in.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
